integration.note: 3 real-subprocess/direct-hook integration behaviors -- see test_completeness rows tagged category=integration

e2e.reason: no browser surface; this is framework Stop-hook + CLI machinery

smoke.reason: no startable server surface in this repo

behaviors.behavior: retire_run_pointer unlinks every pointer file whose own run_id matches, ignoring the session-keyed filename
retire_run_pointer leaves a differently-run_id pointer untouched
retire_run_pointer requires worktree_path before treating a JSON file as a real pointer
retire_run_pointer's pre-unlink re-check survives a same-session pointer overwrite race (doubt-review D3)
retire_run_pointer's re-check swallows a corrupt/torn read instead of raising
a per-file unlink OSError is printed to stderr and the scan continues rather than raising, so a partial retirement is never silent
retire_run_pointer_best_effort swallows every exception and still reports False plus a stderr diagnostic
deliver_pr.py retires the run's pointer on EXIT_DELIVERED and EXIT_CLOSED, never on EXIT_NO_MERGER/EXIT_PENDING
already_audited re-audits a provisional unresolvable-run-id SKIP once the run's own ledger entry appears, and stays final while the entry is still absent (no re-audit loop)
already_audited re-audits a hook-level error finding instead of freezing at 'the audit crashed'
is_stale_unresolvable_run_id_finding falls back to not-stale on a non-dict payload or a malformed-category exception, printing a stderr diagnostic on the exception path (doubt-review D4)
resolve_project_roots redirects audit_root only (never plain_root) to a verified pointer worktree; an explicit env selection wins over a present pointer; a plain-resolver failure falls back to cwd
is_worktree_of verifies the full gitdir back-link chain, rejecting a spoofed container gitdir, a sibling worktree's own admin dir, and a broken or relative back-link
pointer_worktree_root rejects a blank or gone worktree_path and a foreign-session pointer, and falls back safely from a subdirectory cwd or an unexpected exception

the real Stop-hook subprocess re-audits S2 from a provisional SKIP to a real FAIL once the ledger entry appears, both when cwd is already the worktree and when cwd is the MAIN repo with only a pointer naming the worktree (the reachability gap, closed)
the project-wide aggregate tail renders at BOTH the audited worktree and main when a pointer redirects them apart, while the triage backlog write stays anchored at main only

the Stop hook's main() composes pointer resolution, worktree identity verification, per-phase auditing, and dual-root aggregate rendering end to end against a real git worktree + pointer fixture, and one bad phase's exception does not abort the rest
